scripts.test:e2e:persistence: playwright test --config playwright.editor-foundation.config.ts --grep 'saves an eligible review|failed local write|review dialog contains|review dialog remains usable|delayed import|cancel and Escape|does not autoload|inaccessible storage read|corrupt saved slot|failed import keeps|exports actual versioned|imports a valid complete|imported source text|deleting the selected row|deleting an unselected row'

scripts.test:e2e:lists: playwright test --config playwright.editor-foundation.config.ts --grep 'pointer reordering|keyboard reordering|Escape and outside drops|100-point list|reviewed source before and after drop|deleting the selected row|deleting the final point'
